title: Site agent re-check 04/11: phone links follow, the home page card, per-turn apply ids, the step budget after a question, one-language page lists, the site notes store on the host
steps: Run the replace tests: a tel: link in international form (tel:+78005506790, tel:+12125550147) beside a changed number, on the sealed Joomla contract replace and the shared core rule.
Run the chat-input card test: a turns-door answer whose content target is { kind: post, title: demo title, front: true }.
Run the site-call test: the same model-named apply_id on two writes of one turn, then on a write of the next turn, then apply.revert of the name.
Run the step budget tests: nine looks, an answered ask_user_question of 479 s, one look; and ten looks after a settled change.
Run the page-list tests: a 40-language site walked with no locale and no link, and its compact view in site tools.
Run the dsh deploy with a stubbed docker on PATH and HOST_SITES_ROOT=/data/sites, to the end of a new tag.
expect: The link follows: tel:+78005506700 for 8 800 550-67-00, tel:+12125550199 for (212) 555-0199; a number of another shape is linked as written.
The card reads 'Content · the home page'; front: 'yes' marks nothing.
Both writes of one turn go out under one id phone-link-109-<mint>, the next turn under another, and the revert of 'phone-link-109' is sent under the newest.
The answered question restarts the run (no notice), and a run after a change answers changed: true, worded 'since your last change to the site'.
The walk asks one listing of every language then the default language alone, answers locale 'en', and the agent's list names the road to another language.
The notes store is made by a docker run of the deployed image with /data/sites bind-mounted at /site (install -d -m 0700 -o 33 -g 33 /site/.site-notes), before up, and nothing says 'could not make'.
evidence: Dev 04/11/2026 on develop f48f5d667: elite-smiles-dental (Joomla) tel:+12125550147 left after 'change our phone everywhere', Undo 'mixed with another request's' (phone-link-109 on 29/10 and 04/11), '497 s of tool time' after a 479 s answer; los-tacos-no-1 (WordPress) card 'Content · Read the latest News + Blog'; mr-holmes-bakehouse (EmDash, 40 languages) {view:'pages'} 81.5 s. Site notes: no /srv/tracy-sites/.site-notes on the dev host after the deploy, one inside the tracy-runner container.
fence: replace.mjs followHref; turn-undo readTarget; call-memory ownApplyId + normalize ensureApplyId; site-context stepBudget; content-pages walkListing oneLanguageOf + read-compact compactPageList; deploy-host-dsh.sh notes store through the daemon

tests: followLink: a number written with no trunk keeps the link
1.1.0 hotline all:true: a tel: link in international form follows the number too
a write to the static front page reads as the home page through the turns door
🔒 a name the model gives twice in two turns is two changes
stepBudget: an answered question restarts the run, and a run after a change says so
stepBudgetNotice: a run after a change is "since your last change"
a list the relay walked in one language because the site serves many says so
a site in more than eight languages is walked in its default one
a new tag: the site notes store is made through the daemon
